method: sheet tool; 9 sweep crops at 2x, each anchored on opening (r0c0 vertical 'O A D' lettering and railway; r0c1 B.M.6·16 and dotted street grid; r0c2 street corners and heavy boundary; r1c0 road crossing the railway, triangle; r1c1 blue ditch; r1c2 ditch with branch; r2c0 B.M.7·02 and join py ~768; r2c1 ditch ending at the join; r2c2 ditch fork). Contact sheets d1 (8x +-18) and d2 (12x +-13, pheon and 6/8 checks). Every crop and sheet displayed when opened. Dots from a centroid helper, checked on a marker sheet.
legibility: Clear. Horizontal sheet join at py ~768 (strong tint step over the full width; south of it the ditches are drawn uncoloured as double lines, so the lower sheet is a different printing); vertical join / tint step along the strong line at px ~349-351 (north of py 768). The 6·4 at 351,72 sits against the vertical line but reads cleanly.
